programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Renowned UK antiques dealer Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to replenish his collection. On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Car enthusiast Mike Brewer works alongside mechanics to give new life to rundown, classic automobiles in order to resell at a profit. Working with a limited budget, Mike's job is to find and purchase a vehicle and oversee all the necessary repairs - and usually there are plenty of them - giving tips along the way about electrics, structural issues, mechanics, cosmetic touches and finishing work. Once complete, the restored car is taken for a test drive, and then Mike negotiates the purchase price with a new owner. The first 13 seasons of `Wheeler Dealers' featured master mechanic Edd China as Brewer's sidekick.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: Remember that cherished vintage car that's been collecting dust just waiting for a little love? `Garage Squad' rescues weekend mechanics who perhaps lack the time, resources or simple know-how to get their `project' autos road-worthy again. National Hot Rod Association world champion driver Bruno Massel, co-host Heather Storm and lead mechanic Joe Zolper bring expertise, parts and tools as they crash the garages of amateurs who are in over their heads under the hood. After working alongside the owners to ensure the perfect vehicular vision, the squad returns the completed cars for an emotional reuniting of man and machine.

programme.title: Faster With Finnegan
programme.desc: Armed with several years' worth of mechanical expertise, Mike Finnegan and his robust friends never shy away from fulfilling challenging tasks.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning "Deadliest Catch," follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Om Shanti Om
programme.desc: Om, a junior film artist, is smitten by Shantipriya, a renowned actress, but is killed while trying to save her from a fire accident. Thirty years later, he is reborn and sets out to avenge her death.

programme.title: Bal Ganesh And The Pomjom Planet IV
programme.desc: Bal Ganesh's friends accidentally crash-land on a planet named Pomzom, where they are held captive. Bal Ganesh must rush to save his friends.

programme.title: Gupt
programme.desc: After his stepfather is murdered, Sahil gets arrested, but he manages to escape prison to prove his innocence. However, Inspector Udham Singh sets off to capture him.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Majboor
programme.desc: India 1974; Thriller; Dir. Ravi Tandon; Cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Parveen Babi. Ravi leads a good life with his mother & sister. When he learns that he is ill, he falsely takes the blame for a murder.

programme.title: Jai Maa Vaishno Devi
programme.desc: A childless couple are devotees of goddess Vaishno Devi and organise a ritual to receive her blessings. However, when a demon destroys the ritual, the goddess herself takes action.

programme.title: Bhagam Bhag
programme.desc: Champak and his theatre troupe travel to London for a show. However, their plans go awry when they accidentally become pawns in a murder and drug conspiracy.

programme.title: Charanon Ki Saugandh
programme.desc: After returning to his village, Ravi learns that the local farmers are being oppressed by a despotic landlord. Soon, he decides to contest the panchayat elections against the tyrant and put an end to his cruel rule.

programme.title: Dil Hai Tumhaara
programme.desc: Sarita raises Shalu, her spouse's love child, and her daughter, Nimmi, but she does not forgive Shalu's past. When she discovers that Shalu is growing close to Nimmi's lover, things become worse.

programme.title: Bichhoo
programme.desc: Jeeva, a young man, becomes a professional assassin after the death of his family and girlfriend. Later, he meets Kiran and takes her under his wing so that she can avenge her family.

programme.title: Feels Like Summer
programme.desc: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.title: Feels Like Finding Yourself

programme.title: Feels Like Family
programme.desc: The boys are at Lakshay's family home for his sister's wedding. As Avi and Gandhi gear up to get lucky, Sameer has a significant revelation. programme.title: The Protégé

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: An ex-special forces operative wages a one man war through the streets of Amsterdam to rescue his friend's daughter from the local crime syndicate.

programme.title: Feels Like Rock Bottom

programme.desc: Popular British architectural show `Grand Designs' heads Down Under for this version, presented by Australian architect Peter Maddison. programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. "Monsters and Mysteries in America" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

"Monsters and Mysteries in America" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.title: Uthraa
programme.desc: People of Vattaparai are scared to get their children married because a ghost kills the couple during their first night.Six college students come to the village to study about the incident.The villagers are unwelcoming as they have been suffering a lot.The students to prove that what the villagers believed was superstituos.So they stage a drama faking the wedding of two students.Villagers also start to belive them.They also arrange for a wedding in the village,but the young couple are killed during their first night. What happens next forms the rest of the story.

programme.title: Quincy Jones: 'Q' conducting his 'Dream Band'
programme.desc: "Jazz Icons: Quincy Jones" spotlights a young 'Q' conducting his "dream band": an 18-piece orchestra of world-renowned players such as Clark Terry, Phil Woods, Sahib Shihab, Budd Johnson and Benny Bailey. This recording features 5 songs and is one of the finest examples of big band jazz ever to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium in 1961, this concert is one of the few known visual documents of this legendary tour.

programme.title: Swinging Herd Live in England 1964
programme.desc: Featuring a blistering one-hour concert from 1964, showcasing one of the hot line-ups of the Swinging Herd.

programme.title: Bandit 65 -- Jazzfest Bonn
programme.desc: Bandit 65 is a trio of guitarists Kurt Rosenwinkel and Tim Motzer with percussionist Gintas Janusonis; with great power and astounding beauty they explore the intersection of rhythm and soundscape in free improvisations.

programme.title: Concertgebouw, Amsterdam 1958 - Oscar Peterson Trio and Ella Fitzgerald
programme.desc: On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson's trio, American violinist Stuff Smith, and American singer Ella Fitzgerald during the Jazz at the Philharmonic concert at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Jason Moran and Robert Glasper Duet At La Gaité Lyrique, Blue Note Festival
programme.desc: As part of the Blue Note Jazz Festival and Blue Note Records' 75th anniversary, pianists Robert Glasper and Jason Moran deliver a jazz piano duet, resulting in an exploration of the history of jazz.

programme.title: Animal Armoury
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.desc: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid

In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured. The results of some of their experiments include a man forgetting his fiancee, strangers giving away their car keys, and a boxer becoming unable to crush a foam cup.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning "Deadliest Catch," follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

The show features master manipulators, including professional poker player Liv Boeree and mentalism expert Lewis Le Val, who use their abilities to influence others' actions. The results of some of their experiments include a man forgetting his fiancee, strangers giving away their car keys, and a boxer becoming unable to crush a foam cup.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Founded by a devout Christian after having a paranormal encounter, The Tennessee Wraith Chasers investigate the most haunted towns in the United States. The team employs courage, wits and technology to find the truth behind the mystery.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: A retelling of the truly chilling, real-life stories of people who shared their homes and their lives with loved ones who turned into killers. Plus, interviews and firsthand accounts of the critical moments leading up to the vicious acts.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?

The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time, using raw and unfiltered footage, including body-cam and surveillance footage, to bring out the truth.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.desc: Mithran, a driven and successful CEO, becomes emotionally entangled with his newcomer staff, Neera�though both are already in relationships. Shrisha, Mithran�s partner, prioritizes her career and resists settling down, while Neera�s boyfriend Arun, a pilot, is feeling despondent after losing his job. programme.title: Kamu kapi
programme.desc: Ka.Mu � Ka.Pi follows the emotional journey of Anbu and Anu, two colleagues who fall in love and decide to elope, defying their families. Initially, their married life is filled with happiness and hope. But things begin to unravel as Anbu, who dreams of becoming a filmmaker, struggles to find success in the film industry. As financial pressures and emotional stress mount, the couple begins to drift apart. Anbu becomes increasingly absorbed in his ambitions, while Anu feels neglected and questions her decisions and the meaning of love and marriage. Tensions escalate to the point of contemplating divorce.

programme.desc: Sandhya, who lives with her husband Santosh in Chennai, is befriended on Facebook by a dentist named Paramesh, who lives with his wife in Pondicherry. The two chat for hours on WhatsApp. After a year, Santosh Shu finds out about their chat and reprimands her. When he goes to work, she lies to him that she doesn't chat with him and thinks he doesn't know, and Sandhya continues chatting with Paramesh. When Santosh finds out about it and reprimands her, one day Sandhya suddenly dies mysteriously. The police beat Santosh Shu and interrogate him, and the film ends with an explanation of who killed Sandhya and why.

programme.title: Web
programme.desc:
Four girls are kidnapped while returning from a rave party. They were drunk and driving rashly. They wake up to find themselves tied up in a secluded and unkempt bunglow. There is a fifth girl who has been tortured since long. Brutally beaten. The torture begins for these 4 girls. The man and woman who keep them hostage have CCTVs installed in the room where these girls are kept. Thus whenever they try to run away, or make any move are captured back. These goes on for days and then one day the kidnapper kills one of the girl's and feeds her to his dog, as she finds out that her husband has also been killed by the same man.
Later, the woman assisting the kidnapper reveals his story to these girls. The kidnapper had a sister, and she gets killed by a rash driving. Thus anyone who is driving irresponsibly will have to pay the price.
Towards the end these 3 girls manage to escape and reach their homes, only to discover that the kidnapper was actually one of the leading psychiatrist and was requested by their parents to treat the daughters from alcohol and drug abuse and addiction.
Since the traditional methods were tried earlier and lack of cooperation from patients yield no results, thus they reached out to this doctor.
Hence the doctor along with his colleagues & the two friends (whom were thought to have been killed) devise a 21 days treatment plan & everything was just part of it.

programme.title: C'est plus qu'un jardin
programme.desc: Dans cette série documentaire, deux familles découvrent les joies et les défis de l'autosuffisance. Elles peuvent compter sur Jean-Martin Fortier et Dany Bouchard pour les guider dans la réalisation de leurs projets. On passe de la première pelletée de terre à la préparation à l'hiver, en passant par la plantation, la conservation de l'eau, la construction de nichoirs, la congélation et, finalement, la récolte.

programme.title: Curieux Bégin
programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. Christian Bégin nous entraîne dans de délicieuses aventures épicuriennes. Ses invités nous font découvrir plusieurs cultures grâce à leurs expériences et à leurs recettes. Dynamique et pétillante, l'émission "Curieux Bégin" explore de nombreux thèmes dans un univers festif.
